7:DISTRICT ELEMENTARY EDUCATION OFFICER  NAGAO Advocate for the Petitioner : MD S HOQUE Advocate for the Respondent : DY.S.G.I.
 BEFORE
HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ACHINTYA MALLA BUJOR BARUA  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ROBIN PHUKAN
ORDER Date : 22.05.2023 (A.M. Bujor Barua, J) We have read the report dated 22.05.2023 in respect of Juria PS C/No.- 144/23 under Section 420/468 of the IPC.

Para 4 of the report prima facie reveals that the name of two students in the admission register appear with the same serial No. 148 namely,
Banesha Khatun and Harunur Rashid, but the ink that was used to record the name of Banesha Khatun is not similar with that of others of the same register which itself is a prima facie indication that the entry in the school admission register in respect of Banesha Khatun may be a fraudulent entry.
The police to thoroughly investigate the matter, complete the same, bring it to its logical end and submit the report before the Court.
The investigation be also made against any such person who may have been involved in such fraudulent entries being made in the school admission register.
A copy of this order be provided to Ms. U. Das, learned Government Page No.# 3/3 Advocate.
A copy of the report dated 22.05.2023 is kept on record.
